adjudication.rationale: The migration `CreateEmbeddableHosts` copies the old `site_settings.embeddable_hosts` lines into the new `embeddable_hosts` table via raw SQL: `INSERT ... VALUES ('#{h}', ...)` (db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb). This bypasses the `EmbeddableHost` model's `before_validation` normalization that strips `http(s)://` and paths (app/models/embeddable_host.rb), so legacy entries like `http://discourse.org` / `https://example.com/1234` (explicitly supported previously in the removed `SiteSetting.allows_embeddable_host?`) can be persisted with scheme/path. The new check `EmbeddableHost.record_for_host` parses the referer and compares `where("lower(host) = ?", uri.host)`, so a stored value containing `http://...` or a path will not match and embedding will be rejected after upgrade for those hosts.
